description:
Cosmic Pioneer is a solo project by Mounabrata Sarkar tackling the Dancing with the SARs challenge. Combining machine learning, Python data pipelines, and interactive 3D geospatial visualization, I am building a real-time surface-change detection tool powered by NISAR Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data to translate complex radar backscatter and interferometry signals into actionable insights for disaster response and environmental monitoring.

(Competing solo — team roster is closed.)
summary:
Project Cosmic pioneer is an interactive web application designed for the "Dancing with the SARs" challenge. It harnesses Synthetic Aperture Radar data from the NISAR mission to track and visualize dynamic surface changes globally.

By translating complex radar datasets into intuitive visual narratives, the platform allows users to explore critical environmental shifts like wetland loss, wildfires, agricultural cycles, and glacier movement. This makes high-resolution Earth observation data accessible and actionable for global monitoring.
details: Project Cosmic Pioneer is an interactive 3D web application developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge ("Dancing with the SARs") that transforms complex Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) and NISAR HDF5 satellite telemetry into intuitive visual narratives for global environmental monitoring. By rendering L-band SAR interferograms, orbital telemetry, and climate anomaly layers onto an interactive 3D planetary globe and 2D comparative maps with a temporal climate scrubber, the platform allows researchers, disaster planners, educators, and everyday citizens like farmers to track floods, deforestation, glacier movement, and ground deformation without specialized geospatial software. Engineered using Node.js, Vite, HTML5/CSS3, JavaScript, and CesiumJS on the frontend alongside a Python and Flask backend (server.py) in VS Code and Google AI Studio, the app integrates live data feeds from NASA Earthdata, NASA FIRMS, NISAR, SWOT, Sentinel-2/6, Landsat, and the Windy API, while utilizing GitHub, Netlify, and Vercel for deployment and AI models including Gemini, Claude, Argon, Hydrogen Lite, and ElevenLabs for development assistance, an integrated AI co-pilot, and voiceover narration. To maximize creativity, global accessibility, and performance, the team designed a frosted-glass dark-mode interface featuring wireframe-to-satellite globe toggles, an interactive onboarding walkthrough, support for over 90 languages, and a dedicated "Easy Mode" toggle that simplifies technical radar cross-sections into actionable insights for beginners while keeping browser rendering fast and responsive.
